_comment: Supplier candidates matched to the catalogue, from research done 2026-08-12. These are researched options to open accounts with, NOT accounts that exist yet and NOT confirmed SKU matches — supplier catalogues sit behind a login, so the specific item and its price must be confirmed by a human before anything here is treated as real.

_image_rights.position: Supplier photography is the correct source of product images for this shop, because it shows the item the customer actually receives.
_image_rights.rule: Supplier images may be used only in connection with selling that supplier's products, and only within that supplier's own stated terms. Get the permission in writing when you open the account, and keep it.
_image_rights.risk: Using product photography without the rights is copyright infringement. US statutory damages run from $750 to $150,000 per work, so this is not a corner worth cutting.
_image_rights.current_state: Every product currently carries a stock photograph that is NOT the item being sold. That is a placeholder, and it must be replaced with supplier or own photography before real orders are taken.

suppliers.name: Faire
suppliers.why: The standout is net-60 terms for retailers: you receive the stock and pay 60 days later, so a first order can be sold before it is paid for. That is the single biggest cash-flow advantage available to a shop with no capital. Covers home, kitchen, pet and fitness, which are exactly the categories with the fewest options elsewhere. Real brands with real product photography, not generic factory listings.
suppliers.images: Brand-owned photography, usually provided to stockists. Confirm per brand.
suppliers.note: The 25% new / 15% repeat commission quoted online is what Faire charges BRANDS selling on it. As a buyer you pay the wholesale price.

suppliers.name: Blanka
suppliers.why: No MOQ and fast North American shipping, so the lip and skin range can be branded without buying stock up front.
suppliers.images: Product imagery is provided to sellers through the platform; confirm the licence wording when the account is opened.

suppliers.name: SelfNamed
suppliers.why: 100+ ready-made formulations with zero MOQ, EU-certified and FDA-compliant — the shortest route to a serum and SPF that are actually compliant.
suppliers.images: Ready-made lines usually ship with photography; confirm rights in writing.

suppliers.name: YOURS Private Label
suppliers.why: Zero MOQ with orders dispatched in 1–3 business days, which matches the dispatch promise on the site.

suppliers.name: Beauty Joint
suppliers.model: wholesale of existing brands, incl. K-beauty
suppliers.why: Stocking known brands is a different business from private label — lower margin, but no formulation risk and instant credibility.
suppliers.images: Brand-owned imagery. Rights come from the brand, not the wholesaler — check before using.

suppliers.name: JB Jewelry BLVD
suppliers.why: Specifically gold-filled and stainless with no MOQ and 1–7 day US delivery. Gold-fill rather than plated is exactly what the jewelry copy promises, so this is the closest match in the whole catalogue.
suppliers.images: Wholesale accounts typically include product imagery; confirm the licence.

suppliers.name: JewelryODM
suppliers.why: No-MOQ dropshipping with manufacturing behind it, so a piece that sells can be produced as an own-brand run later.

suppliers.name: CJdropshipping
suppliers.model: dropship, global warehouses including North America
suppliers.why: Covers the long tail — lamps, organisers, pet and tech accessories — from a US warehouse, which is the only way the 1–2 day dispatch promise survives for those categories. Image search makes matching an existing listing straightforward.
suppliers.images: Policy permits using supplier images in connection with selling that supplier's products, subject to the individual supplier's terms.

suppliers.name: Spocket
suppliers.why: Vetted US and EU suppliers mean shorter shipping than Asia-direct, which matters most on the items people expect quickly.
suppliers.images: Supplier imagery supplied through the platform; rights are per supplier.

suppliers.name: Tundra
suppliers.why: Secondary to Faire with a smaller network. Worth a look only if a specific brand is not on Faire.

next_steps: Open accounts with JB Jewelry BLVD (jewelry) and one of Blanka or SelfNamed (beauty and skincare) first — those two cover the highest-margin half of the catalogue.
For each product, record the real supplier, their SKU and their landed cost in products.json under sourcing, then replace unit_cost with the real number so the margin report stops being an estimate.
Get written confirmation of image rights at account opening, then set sourcing.image_source to 'supplier' and put the licence reference in sourcing.image_credit.
Run the 'Localise product photos' workflow so the photography is hosted by this repo rather than hotlinked.
Order one of everything to yourself before selling any of it. Photographs and descriptions written from a supplier listing are guesses until you have held the item.

_defunct.abound: Do not spend time on Abound. It was acquired by Carro in early 2024 and the wholesale marketplace no longer exists. It still appears in most 'Faire alternatives' listicles.
